thread:
Ravi: FYI CloudBridge asked for a ShipKit-style partner pack: Terraform modules + one-click listing metadata + a tiny demo app. Goal: list in their marketplace beta.

Marta: Key constraints from CloudBridge: must support both x86 and arm64, include a cost-estimate snippet, and expose a simple `onboard_url` variable for post-install webhook.

Ibrahim: Proposal: single repo with `modules/root`, `modules/aws`, `modules/azure`, `examples/simple-chat`, `ci/`. Root module decides provider. Keeps registry entry sane.

PartnerRep: Correct. Also want tagging for billing: `tags` input required, must include `partner:cloudbridge` in default tags.

Ravi: CI: GitHub Actions that runs `terraform fmt`, `validate`, `init -backend=false` and a lightweight `plan`. Publish to Terraform Registry on semver tag. Use OIDC for sandbox deploys.

Marta: Docs: quickstart for marketplace UI, troubleshooting for AMI/VM size mismatches, instructions for customer-managed KMS, and a short `compatibility.md` (recommended instance families).

Ibrahim: Security: don't bake model weights into AMIs. Provide `model_source` input (options: `pull_from_redwood` | `s3`) and document export-control considerations.

GH-actions-bot: Action created: `cloudbridge-shipkit-beta` -> tasks: scaffold, aws module, azure stub, examples, CI. Assigned: Ravi, Marta, Ibrahim.

Ravi: Owners & quick deadlines: scaffold + root module -> Ravi (7 days). Examples + docs -> Marta (9 days). CI + publish workflow -> Ibrahim (10 days). Partner legal + license -> PartnerRep (5 days).

Marta: One UX ask: expose `deployment_type = "vm" | "k8s"` and `create_s3_bucket = true|false` with opt-in creation. Default false.

Ibrahim: Tests: include a smoke curl to `/health` and a tiny generation request in sandbox. Use tiny instance types for CI to keep cost low.

PartnerRep: Thanks all. I'll share CloudBridge's sample marketplace manifest and a contact on their listing team. We'll want a quick partner review before publishing.

Ravi: I'll open the repo and post the scaffold PR in 48hrs. Ping here if blockers. :rocket:
